content.comment_body: Imported a technical question from [user_name] sent privately.

While I'm not a specialist, you could try setting up your router’s NAT to forward your HTTP port to the internal IP. This allows traffic from your external IP address to be directed to the internal web server’s address. The internal IP refers to the IP address assigned to your web server. Best of luck.
